criterion_summary: A symmetric operator with a dense set of vectors analytic for it is essentially self-adjoint.
checked_application: Finite-particle vectors form a dense invariant domain for the fixed finite quadratic Hamiltonian. Its repeated-action factorial bound gives a positive analytic radius for each vector. The criterion therefore applies. The number-moment propagation and Duhamel estimate were independently reconstructed before this source or the author receipt was opened.
